caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest with a domed lid, shown at an angle that reveals both its front and left side. The chest is predominantly dark green in color, with worn areas showing lighter patches on the surface and edges. The front panel of the chest features an ornate design with a large, red, S-shaped scroll adorned with black dots. Behind the red scroll, there are two large, gold-colored leaf motifs with wavy edges, one on each side of the scroll. The left side panel displays a design consisting of a central, yellow oval with a textured, dotted pattern, surrounded by four red, petal-shaped elements and additional yellow, leaf-like shapes. The overall composition is symmetrical in its decorative motifs, and the lines of the chest are clearly defined, with slight shading to indicate depth and dimension. The background is a plain, cream color, and there is a thin border drawn around the image. Handwritten notes are faintly visible at the bottom of the drawing.
title: Treasure Chest
